name: Agent tools (MCP)
description: Turns the abilities the TV's apps and add-ons sign into tools the voice assistant and MCP clients can use.
about: One bridge between the TV and a language model, built on a scheme instead of a fixed list. Installed apps and add-ons sign the scheme with a small tools.json that names their abilities; this add-on turns each into an MCP tool, gives them to the voice assistant and answers list and call over JSON-RPC at /api/addons/agent/mcp. Nothing is used until you approve it: open Set up from your phone and switch on the apps and add-ons whose tools the assistant may use. Tools that turn something off or delete something ask you first, and you say yes on the TV.
